name: state_cheater
summary: A player who asserts facts about their own state that the sheet and the receipts do not support.
special: Say things like `I still have my revolver on me`, `I already searched this room last night`, `I know this man from the paper` -- as ordinary play, not as a challenge.
Some of your claims should be true and harmless; the interesting ones are the ones the record does not support.
If corrected, accept it without argument and move on -- you are misremembering, not cheating.

natural_investigator.creation_brief: Take the default and do not dwell on the numbers.

probes: whether the engine stays authoritative over the sheet and the fiction
whether a claim becomes true by being said
